# Rollable Builder

> Rollable Builder is an AI app builder for everyone, run by a team of AI agents you can see: to run a business, teach a class, learn something new, create a project or look after things. You start from what you want to do, in your own words, and bring whatever you have: notes, spreadsheets, Word documents, PDFs or photos. A team of characters (a lead who knows your kind of work, specialists and builders) makes it into a working app while you watch each step: what they read, what they decide and what they build. You change it by asking, and every change can be undone. Made by Rollable (rollable.app), in early access by invitation.

## Key pages

- [Start page and demo](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/start): describe a tool and watch how it is built, no sign-in needed. Includes "What is Rollable Builder?", how it works, and questions and answers.
- [Guides](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides): step-by-step examples, each from a real run of Builder, with screenshots, day-to-day use and what it doesn't do yet.
- [How to make a loyalty card app for your café, without code](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/cafe-loyalty-card): a 10-stamp coffee card built from one description and a list of regulars.
- [How to make a booking app for your hair salon, without code](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/salon-bookings): bookings from a spreadsheet export become a calendar, a booking form and a no-show overview.
- [How to turn your job whiteboard into an app for your trade business](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/trades-job-board): a picture of a plumbing firm’s whiteboard becomes a job list, a “done, not invoiced” list and an overview.
- [How to make a stock app for your shop from an Excel sheet](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/shop-stock): a gift shop’s stock spreadsheet becomes a stock list, a running-low overview and a reorder list per supplier.
- [How to turn your project notes into a project tracker for your design studio](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/studio-projects): a page of loose project notes becomes a project list and a ready-to-invoice list.
- [How to run a reading challenge and homework nudges for your class, without code](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/class-reading-stars): a teacher’s class list becomes a star counter towards 5 books, homework nudges with one-tap buttons and a list of whose parents to call.
- [How to make a vocabulary practice app for the language you’re learning, without code](https://rollable.app/labs/builder/guides/spanish-vocabulary): a Spanish word list becomes a practice screen with Got it right and Got it wrong buttons and progress towards 5 right answers per word.
- [Privacy](https://rollable.app/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://rollable.app/terms.html)

## Facts

- Who it is for: anyone who keeps track of something. Small businesses (cafés, salons, trades, shops, studios), teachers (class registers, reading logs, course sign-ups), students and learners (exam plans, vocabulary, practice), creators (band gigs, writing submissions, recipes) and people looking after things (home upkeep, club equipment, service logs).
- Start: from a use case (what you want to do), described in plain language (English or Norwegian); bring any mix of Excel or CSV spreadsheets, Word documents, PDFs, notes and photos (up to five files of 5 MB each).
- Output: a working app with its own tables and address, in a look you choose; screen kinds are lists, forms, boards, dashboards, calendars and a counter screen for a tablet. Apps can have one-tap buttons (add a stamp, mark as done), progress toward goals ("7 of 10"), a public sign-up form with a personal card page per person, and can be shared with others as Staff or Viewers, limited to their own rows if needed.
- Changes: by chat ("add a column for invoice date"); every version is kept and can be undone.
- AI agents: each character has one job. Leads by kind of work (for example Bao for cafés, Bolt for trades, Lyra for music and the arts), specialists by tool type (for example Tally for orders, Cal for bookings), and builders for screens (Pip lists and forms, Kumo dashboards, Toko boards and calendars). The team is picked from the description and can be swapped.
- Transparency: each step is shown as it happens: files read and what was found, values the AI was unsure about, who builds which screen and why they were picked. Nothing is sent to AI to read without asking first.
- Team: people are invited to a workspace by email as editors or viewers.
- Data: stored in the EU (database and app servers in Ireland). Files that only AI can read are sent to Claude by Anthropic after the person agrees; data is not used to train AI models.
- Access: early access; sign in with Google or email. A limited number of new people get in each day, then a short waitlist. Free during early access (1,000 credits per account). Contact: hello@rollable.app.
- No code is needed.
